sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob.
Whether it be along a recent battlefield, an abandoned dungeon...
The Memorial Mob will make an appearance.
If you seek them out, they'll surely present their wares.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Shugendo: on the cliff the rafters opposite the Sculptor's Idol lead to.

sections.heading: Senpou Temple ( Inner Sanctum )
sections.text: Defeat the Folding Screen Monkeys to meet the Divine Child of Rejuvenation.

sections.heading: Senpou Temple (Shugendo)
sections.text: Talk to the Shugendo Memorial Mob to receive Persimmon [x1].

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace (Fountainhead Palace)
sections.text: Upon defeating the Corrupted Monk, the Dragon's Tally Board she drops will unlock new items at every merchant.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts ( Outskirts Wall - Stairway )
sections.text: Complete Anayama's questline (see his page for in depth info) to acquire the Promissory Note, which will discount by 10% the cost of every item sold by merchants.

sections.heading: Quest Item
sections.text:
Persimmon x1
(Given after Wolf meets the Divine Child)

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
First Encounter with a Mob | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Wolf: An offering?
Memorial Mob: Indeed. I sell items to be offered to the dead, so they might rest in peace. From the looks of you, I'd wager you have a lot of blood on your hands. ...go ahead, buy an offering.
First Encounter | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Wolf: Another one...
Memorial Mob: Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob... There'll be none to mourn you should you forget the Buddha. ...go ahead, buy an offering.
Talking After Encountering the Divine Child | Memorial Mob: ...Have you met the Divine Child of the Rejuvenating Waters? It was by a hair's breadth, but mercifully, she survived. Though she must have suffered greatly... You'd best treat her kindly. Here. This is from me. (Gives Persimmon). I wanted to share it with all the children...
Talking Again | Memorial Mob: ...Have you met the Divine Child of the Rejuvenating Waters? It was by a hair's breadth, but mercifully, she survived. Though she must have suffered greatly... You'd best treat her kindly.
Greeting (Generic) | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Leaving (Generic) | Memorial Mob: May the departed rest in peace...
When Infected with Dragonrot | Memorial Mob: Buddha's just... and righteous punishment. I had no idea the Divine Children... Were suffering so badly... I see now... I must... make an offering...

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- When bought, the Five-Colour Rice will only have 1 use out of 5 available.
- Only merchant to sell Persimmons.
